implementation.summary: D34 preserves the D33 slotted-dataclass FinOps fix while restoring the legacy __dict__ payload contract used by existing control-plane helpers. Dataclass fields remain authoritative for UsageRecord, CostRecord and BudgetPolicy; legacy records still omit private fields and normalize enum/time/numeric values as before. The campaign reruns FinOps budgets, actual/estimated costs, labels, allocation, forecast, budget gate and observability policy contracts, plus a real OTLP Collector provider lane.
